title: Several modules are forcibly re-enabled on every restart/logon
author: MajorTanya

judgment.rationale: The issue discussion links the module enablement symptom to #50616's general-settings reset and says fixes are being applied. PR #51115, specifically titled to prevent startup and read-only settings overwrites, has merged; PR #51292 for atomic general-settings publication remains open. This is existing fix work, not a separate design. The upstream issue remains open and should not be closed by this refresh.
evidence: The reporter says Awake, Command Palette, and Mouse Highlighter re-enable after restart/logon.
The maintainer says #50616 concerns reset enabled/disabled preferences and that both reports may share an underlying problem, while agreeing to keep this issue open until known.
PR #51115, 'prevent startup and read-only settings overwrites,' is merged; PR #51292, 'publish native general settings atomically,' is open.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep this report linked to the existing settings-persistence fix effort and revalidate after the fixes ship; do not create a competing design or close the open upstream issue.

fix_assessment.rationale: The related settings-reset issue and maintainer discussion identify the likely shared persistence failure; a directly relevant PR has merged and an atomic-write follow-up is open. The current evidence does not justify a competing fix plan.

inferences: The module toggles may reflect the same general-settings file reset/persistence path described in #50616 rather than independent module-specific re-enablement.
